ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Order_Item__c)), OR(Product__c <> Order_Item__r.Product__c, Invoice__r.Sales_Order__c <> Order_Item__r.Sales_Order__c)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Inventory__c)), OR(Product__c <> Inventory__r.Product__c, Invoice__r.Distributor__c <> Inventory__r.Distributor__c)))
